newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar closes flat at 476/477 dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar closes flat at 476/477 dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 476.00/477.00 bolivars per dollar as the Central Bank covered some corporate demand, brokers said.
"There is some demand, above all from corporate clients who take positions," one trader said. He said the Central Bank intervened "decisively."

Another broker noted some foreign investors' presence to buy TEMs due to higher yields at Wednesday's auction. Interest rates as measured by the yield on benchmark six-month TEMs rose 112 basis points to 16.48 percent.
